data.title: Special encounters expected in Al Ittihad vs NEOM… | Yalla Shoot
data.content:
Al Ittihad are relying on their strong results in Jeddah, having achieved four consecutive home victories, during which they scored nine goals. However, they face a rival who previously halted their winning streak last season.

Al Ittihad's numbers during November do not seem perfect; they achieved 21 wins in 49 matches this month, alongside 14 draws and 14 losses, bringing their loss percentage to 29%. [...] A key Algerian clash features Houssem Aouar of Al Ittihad and Saïd Benrahma of NEOM SC, as both aim to deliver impactful performances to help their teams secure three points.

The previous encounters between the two clubs have produced exciting results; Al Ittihad won the first match 3-1, before NEOM SC responded with a thrilling 4-3 victory, as the hosts look to change this equation. [...] Saïd Benrahma has scored four goals in seven matches this season, having netted ten goals in 23 matches last season. Meanwhile, Youssef En-Nesyri has found the net twice against NEOM SC and has scored 13 goals over the last two seasons in the Saudi Pro League without providing any assists.
